query:
SELECT ph.cardId, ph.grade, CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as hkdPrice, ph.jpyPrice, DATE(ph.soldAt) as soldDate, c.nameJa
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL) BETWEEN 1000 AND 1500
ORDER BY ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 15;
